1.explanation:
• date-picker2/index.md & index.en-us.md: Show DatePicker2 props including timePanelProps.description and examples.
• date-picker2/demo/show-time.md: Demonstrates usage of showTime/timePanelProps and defaultValue behavior in DatePicker2.
• date-picker2/adaptor/index.jsx: Contains the core logic that parses timePanelProps and passes defaultValue into the time panel; investigating here reveals how defaultValue is handled.
• time-picker2/adaptor/index.jsx: Implements the TimePicker component which actually renders the time panel – necessary to trace how defaultValue is consumed and converted into display values.
• time-picker2/demo/default-value.md: Documents how TimePicker handles defaultValue; good for comparing intended behavior vs. actual in DatePicker2’s embedded time picker.
1.bug_scenario: The DatePicker2 component is configured with timePanelProps.defaultValue, but when opening the calendar with time panel enabled, the time panel header shows “Invalid Date” instead of the expected default time value. The date panel on the left displays “2021年7月” correctly, but the three time columns on the right (hours, minutes, seconds) are rendered with header “Invalid Date” and zeroed list items (0, 0, 0), indicating the defaultValue was not parsed or passed correctly.
